title.en: Anthropic closes $93.5B Nasdaq IPO and $26B concurrent private placement
title.zhHans: Anthropic 完成 935 亿美元纳斯达克 IPO 及 260 亿美元同期私募配售

searchSummary.en: After pricing at $83 per share on November 18 and debuting on Nasdaq under ticker ANT on November 19, Anthropic closed a $93.5B IPO and $26.0B private placement on November 20.
searchSummary.zhHans: 继 11 月 18 日以每股 83 美元定价、11 月 19 日以代码 ANT 登陆纳斯达克后，Anthropic 于 11 月 20 日完成 935 亿美元 IPO 及 260 亿美元同期私募配售交割。

summary.en: On November 20, 2026, Anthropic announced the closing of its initial public offering of 1,127,000,000 Class A shares at $83.00 per share (approximately $93.5 billion in total gross proceeds before underwriting discounts and offering expenses, including full exercise of the underwriters' 147,000,000-share option; approximately $91.6 billion in gross proceeds went to Anthropic, with the remainder to selling stockholders) alongside a concurrent $26.0 billion private placement of 313,253,007 Class N shares to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and TSMC Partners (combined gross proceeds approximately $119.5 billion). Shares priced on November 18 and began trading on Nasdaq under symbol ANT on November 19, before sliding below the $83 IPO price by November 24 amid broader AI equity volatility.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 宣布完成首次公开募股交割，以每股 83.00 美元公开发行总计 11.27 亿股 A 类普通股（含承销商全额行使 1.47 亿股超额配售选择权，扣除承销费用前总募集额约 935 亿美元，其中归属 Anthropic 的费用前总募集额约 916 亿美元，其余来自售股股东），并同期向 AMD、Broadcom、Google、Micron、Microsoft、NVIDIA 与 TSMC Partners 私募配售 313,253,007 股 N 类普通股（约 260 亿美元），合并总募集额约 1,195 亿美元。该发行于 11 月 18 日定价、11 月 19 日以 ANT 代码在纳斯达克开始交易，随后在 AI 板块波动中于 11 月 24 日回落至 83 美元发行价下方。

narrative.en: Following its November 10 IPO roadshow, Anthropic completed its transition to a publicly traded company on Nasdaq under ticker ANT. While the combined $119.5 billion raise—anchored by seven major semiconductor and cloud suppliers buying Class N shares—established a landmark public-market capital event for frontier AI, secondary trading proved volatile: shares dropped 9% on their second trading day amid a broader Nasdaq sell-off and fell to $75.61–$76.60 by November 24. Long-term operating performance and structural effects on external competitors remain to be observed.
narrative.zhHans: 继 11 月 10 日启动路演后，Anthropic 完成了以代码 ANT 在纳斯达克上市的公开化转折。此次合并约 1,195 亿美元的筹资（含七家头部芯片与云供应商认购 N 类股）成为前沿 AI 领域的标志性资本市场事件，但二级市场走势剧烈波动：上市次日股价回调 9% 并伴随纳斯达克 AI 板块抛售，至 11 月 24 日跌至 75.61 至 76.60 美元区间。其长期盈利能力及对外部竞争格局的结构性影响仍有待持续观察。

text.en: Anthropic priced its Class A IPO at $83.00 per share on November 18, began Nasdaq trading under symbol ANT on November 19, and closed 1,127,000,000 Class A shares (~$93.5B gross) plus a concurrent 313,253,007 Class N private placement (~$26.0B) to seven chip and cloud firms on November 20, 2026.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2026 年 11 月 18 日将 A 类普通股 IPO 定价为每股 83.00 美元，11 月 19 日以 ANT 代码在纳斯达克挂牌交易，并于 11 月 20 日完成 11.27 亿股 A 类股（总募资约 935 亿美元）及向七家芯片与云厂商同期私募配售 313,253,007 股 N 类股（约 260 亿美元）的交割。

text.en: Anthropic's listing and $119.5 billion combined raise moved a frontier AI lab into public equity markets alongside seven major chip and cloud investors, while second-day ANT trading fell 9% amid a wider Nasdaq AI stock sell-off.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 上市及 1,195 亿美元合并募资使头部前沿 AI 实验室与七家芯片及云巨头正式在公开市场形成股权绑定，而 ANT 上市次日大跌 9% 并伴随纳斯达克 AI 板块广泛抛售。

text.en: Post-IPO market reception was contested: by November 24, 2026, ANT shares had slipped to $75.61–$76.60, below the $83 IPO price, reflecting investor concerns over competition, data-center spending, and valuation.
text.zhHans: 上市后市场评价存在明显分歧：至 2026 年 11 月 24 日，ANT 股价已回落至 75.61–76.60 美元，跌破 83 美元发行价，反映投资者对竞争、数据中心资本开支与估值的担忧。

description.en: Completed transition of a major frontier AI developer to Nasdaq public trading with ~$119.5B combined IPO and strategic private-placement gross proceeds, though immediate secondary trading turned volatile.
description.zhHans: 完成头部前沿 AI 开发者在纳斯达克的公开上市与约 1,195 亿美元合并募资，但初期二级市场交易出现明显波动。
